# CS-003: Behind a tunnel, an L7 bouncer enforces bans

- **Group:** CrowdSec and fail2ban
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check reports `unknown`, never a pass.

## Why it matters

Behind a Cloudflare Tunnel every request reaches the host from cloudflared, a local process or container. A firewall bouncer bans source addresses at the packet filter, so it never sees the real client and bans nothing that matters. Enforcement has to happen in the proxy (Traefik, Caddy, nginx bouncer) or at Cloudflare.

## Verify by hand

```sh
sudo cscli bouncers list
```

## How to fix it

Use the proxy bouncer (or the Cloudflare bouncer) together with a parser that reads the real client address
